biography.value: Boulder Giants are the point at which Stone Nephilim become genuinely threatening to organized groups. Ground Tremor disrupts formation positioning on arrival. Mountain Fist builds toward a Grapple that enemies find very difficult to escape. Mountain Hurl's debris damage means clustered enemies take area damage even when the throw targets only one. A summoner who has patience and keeps the Boulder Giant engaged consistently will find attrition steadily resolves in their favor.

system.attacksNotes:
Mountain Fist [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 5 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (8 + 6 Str).
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up); target Grappled + Prone; no save; ongoing 8 bludgeoning damage per round.
  • Margin 3: 14 damage, DR halved (round up) + Grappled + Prone + Restrained; ongoing damage increases to 14; Fortitude [Hard] save each round to break free.

Mountain Hurl [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 4), Range: 80/160 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 14 damage (11 + 3 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 14 damage, DR halved (round up); target knocked Prone + Stunned until end of their next turn; all creatures within 10 feet take 6 bludgeoning damage.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Immovable: Cannot be knocked Prone by non-magical forced movement. Shoves automatically fail unless the attacker wins an opposed Strength + Athletics [Hard] check. Earth Bond: While on natural earth or stone, regains 6 HP at the start of its turn. Suppressed if it took magical damage this round. Powerful Build: Boulder Giant counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Stone Grip: Creatures Grappled by the Boulder Giant add 2 to both dice on Athletics, Acrobatics, and Might checks to escape. Ground Tremor (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, stamps the ground. All creatures within 20 feet on natural ground make a Reflex save (compare Agil 2 + Might 6 targeting vs. save). Designated allies immune.

  • Margin 1:: 10 bludgeoning damage + Prone.
  • Margin 2: 10 bludgeoning damage, DR halved (round up) + Prone + Restrained by cracking ground.

Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
system.reactionsNotes: Stone Skin [Reaction]: Once per round, reduce incoming physical damage by 6. Resilient Defense (1/day): When the Boulder Giant fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead.
